title.narrative: ICMPS NEW GUINEA BINATANG RESEARCH CENTRE V035 CANBERRA

description.narrative: New Guinea Binatang Research Center (BRC) will deliver a 2 week in-village training program for communities from Mt Wilhelm Conservation Area (MWCA), Madang and Simbu Province. MWCA is a 20,000ha conservation initiative which supports research on ecology, rainforest regeneration and climate change effects on rainforest systems. The course will build on our extensive experience with capacity building programs for conservation communities and is tailored to 1) build understanding and resilience around climate change impacts, while 2) reducing pressure on native primary forests. This strategy will both reduce the impacts of climate change on these vulnerable communities, and at the same time build support and evidenced based strategies for conservation so that forests there will remain protected, contributing to carbon storage, biodiversity preservation, and climate research.
